title: bromus arvensis subsp. patulus
intro: Bromus arvensis subsp. patulus, commonly known as wild brome or cheat grass, is a type of grassy weed that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Bromus arvensis subsp. patulus include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe and protect the body from infection and damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
